verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no explicit documentation or claims about load-based autoscaling for traffic bursts; only tangential items like isolated containers (vercel-docs-12) and a community complaint about surprise billing during undetected DDoS traffic (vercel-comm-12) exist, neither of which documents or confirms automatic scaling behavior. Missing for 10: any first-party docs on autoscaling limits/mechanics, load testing or burst-handling case studies, and independent verification that traffic spikes are absorbed without manual intervention.
